title: SimPhony: A Device-Circuit-Architecture Cross-Layer Modeling and Simulation Framework for Heterogeneous Electronic-Photonic AI System
problem: Electronic-photonic integrated circuits (EPICs) for AI require innovations across devices, circuits, architecture, and design automation. Lack of unified simulation framework prevents exploration of hardware innovations and evaluation on common benchmarks.
motivation: EPICs offer transformative potential for next-generation AI systems, but complexity across hybrid electronic-photonic design stack necessitates integrated simulation framework.
method: SimPhony provides cross-layer modeling and simulation: generic extensible hardware topology for heterogeneous multi-core photonic tensor cores; optics-specific dataflow with multi-dimensional parallelism; data-aware energy modeling with device responses, area estimation, link budget and bandwidth-adaptive memory; seamless hardware/software co-simulation integration with model training frameworks.
key_novelty: First unified cross-layer simulation framework for electronic-photonic AI systems supporting optics-specific dataflow modeling beyond spatial/temporal dimensions.
contributions: Generic extensible hardware topology representation for heterogeneous EPIC multi-core architectures
Optics-specific dataflow modeling with multi-dimensional parallelism beyond spatial/temporal
Data-aware energy modeling with realistic device responses and layout-aware area estimation
Seamless integration with model training frameworks for hardware/software co-simulation

metrics.other: cross-layer fidelity and simulation speed metrics not specified

primary_theme: Cross-layer simulation framework for heterogeneous electronic-photonic AI systems
